description: Extension methods for VoiceWakeOverlayController managing speech session UI, including starting, updating, presenting, dismissing, and handling user interactions for voice wake sessions.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice wake session with provided parameters, resets relevant state, and presents the overlay.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current session state including token, source, text, and visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the overlay with partial transcript, resets UI state, only if token matches current session.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Presents the final transcript, optionally schedules auto-send after a delay, and updates UI state.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Sets UI into editing mode, cancels auto-send tasks.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels editing state and dismisses the overlay.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay with new text, resets sending state, and updates UI.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Sets the UI into sending state, optionally plays a chime, and dismisses the overlay shortly after.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests sending of current session via the coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay with animation, resets state, and notifies relevant components.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the input level indicator if token matches and sufficient time has passed.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to verify if incoming token matches the active token, determining whether to accept or drop.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an auto-send task after a delay for the given token, ensuring only the latest auto-send is active.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString from plain text with default styling.
